title: Red After Midnight
logline: A homebound teenager finds Manchester United through late-night counter-attacks — and learns that loyalty outlasts winning.
audience: Late-night football kids, diaspora friends, and anyone who fell for a club before they understood form tables.
intent: By the end, the viewer should feel that support can become identity — kept even when the glory years fade.

narration.en: From twelve, home was my world. I did not wander far.
narration.am: ከአስራ ሁለት ዓመቴ ጀምሮ ቤት ዓለሜ ነበር። ሩቅ አልዘወርም ነበር።

narration.en: Late games on the old TV, near eleven or midnight, while the city slept.
narration.am: ከከተማው እንቅልፍ ጋር፣ ሌሊት አሥራ አንድ ወይም እኩለ ሌሊት አካባቢ፣ በድሮው ቲቪ ላይ ጨዋታዎችን እመለከት ነበር።

shots.reason: Many clubs passed before one stuck — discovery, not destiny.

shots.motionPrompt: slow horizontal pan across soft colour blurs, gentle TV flicker

narration.en: I watched many sides — Arsenal’s peaks, Blackburn’s brief glory, and more.
narration.am: ብዙ ቡድኖችን አይቻለሁ — የአርሰናል ከፍታዎችን፣ የብላክበርን አጭር ክብርን እና ሌሎችንም።

narration.en: Then Ferguson’s United: fast, ruthless counter-attacks that finished opponents early.
narration.am: ከዚያ የፈርጉሰን ዘመን ዩናይትድ — ፈጣን፣ ጨካኝ የተቃራኒ ጥቃቶች ተቃዋሚዎችን በፍጥነት የሚጨርሱ።

narration.en: Support became habit — then something closer to addiction.

narration.en: Happiest night: eight goals at Old Trafford against Arsenal.

narration.en: And Rooney’s overhead kick — a stadium forgetting to breathe.
narration.am: እና የሩኒ የላይኛው ኳስ ምት — ስታዲየሙ መተንፈስ የረሳበት ቅጽበት።

narration.en: Form comes and goes. The love does not.
narration.am: ቅርጽ ይመጣል ይሄዳል። ፍቅሩ ግን አይጠፋም።

shots.reason: Close on lifelong support; lead into AI end card.

narration.en: Some loyalties you choose once — and keep for life.
